messages:
Incidents Bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered INC-2026-345 — elevated 504s from hosted-gateway-us-west1 (10m). >5% error rate. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/ops/gateway/US-WEST1
Maria Chen: ACK — I'm on it. Pulling traces and ingress graphs now.
Maria Chen: 504s concentrated on ingress-nodes a,c,e. Upstream error = connect/timeout to model-proxy v1.
Maria Chen: Noticed something odd: many failed requests don't have x-request-id in logs/traces (approx ~40%). Traces seem under-sampled.
Recon Bot: Trace sampling config shows sample_rate=0.01 for gateway cluster, last deployment changed tracing flags 2026-03-14.
Jamal Ortiz: That sampling is too low for debugging this. Also check envoy request-id filter — if header not propagated, we lose correlation. Can someone check the envoy filter chain?
Sophia Li: I can push a tiny shim to add a generated request-id at ingress for any request missing it, and log it. Will run as canary (10%) initially to avoid log storm.
Maria Chen: Keep logs minimal: only request_id, upstream_id, path, upstream_latency. Example envoy filter snippet to add (hotpatch):
```yaml
- name: envoy.filters.http.header_to_metadata
  typed_config:
    "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.header_to_metadata.v3.Config
    request_rules:
      - header: x-request-id
        on_header_present:
          metadata_namespace: envoy.request
          key: request_id
        on_header_missing:
          metadata_namespace: envoy.request
          key: request_id
          value: "generated"
```
Deploy Bot: Canary rollout started: ingress-debug-shim -> canary (10%) build b4392. Awaiting manual pause/approve.
Jamal Ortiz: Given customer impact, we should also route some traffic to model-proxy v2 as a short fallback — v2 has lower tail latency. Not ideal long-term but can reduce 504s quickly.
Maria Chen: Agreed. Start fallback routing to v2 for 30s window, monitor error rate and latency. Jamal, can you apply routing override? @Jamal Ortiz
Jamal Ortiz: Done — applied temporary routing override preferring model-proxy-v2 for 30s. :white_check_mark:
Recon Bot: After routing override, 504 rate dropped from 6.2% -> 2.1% within 60s. Latency for v2 is stable. Traces still sparse for non-canary traffic.
Sophia Li: Debug shim is live on canary. Sample log line for canary traffic:
```
[ingress-canary] req=01ab23cd host=api-gateway path=/v1/generate upstream=model-proxy-v2 pid=2345 latency_ms=212 request_id=01ab23cd
```
Maria Chen: Recommend increasing canary to 50% for 15m to capture broader patterns. Will produce only the minimal fields. Jamal, are we OK with extra log volume?
Jamal Ortiz: OK for 15m. Do it, but revert after collection window.
Maria Chen: Handoff: I'm out in ~20m. Summary for next on-call: elevated 504s due to upstream v1 timeouts; mitigated by short routing to v2 which reduced customer impact; missing request-id propagation observed on some ingress nodes — deployed debug shim to canary and expanding to 50% for 15m to collect correlating logs/traces. Action items: (1) Jamal to continue monitoring and revert shim at end of window, (2) follow up with infra on envoy filter drift on nodes a/c/e, (3) create incident doc and start p0 timeline. Incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-345
Jamal Ortiz: Taking over. I'll keep the routing override and watch the metrics, then coordinate a postmortem. Will tag SRE infra for envoy filter audit. :mag_right:
Incidents Bot: Pager reassigned to Jamal Ortiz. Please ACK when you have stable mitigations or need escalation. :white_check_mark:
